name: code-block
title: CodeBlock
description: Code inside a reply or doc: syntax-highlighted from the theme (TS/JS/JSX, CSS, JSON, shell, HTML built in; Shiki or Prism pluggable), language and filename, copy (button, floating button or ⌘C), soft-wrap, line numbers. Snippet is the one-line, copy-first form for install commands and imports.
